messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I need to swap weekend oncall. I can't cover Sat/Sun (family thing). Can anyone take the Sat shift (00:00-12:00 UTC) and I'll cover Sun (12:00-23:59 UTC)?
Caroline: I can take Saturday morning shift (00:00-06:00 UTC) but I have a meeting at 08:30 my timezone, so prefer to hand off by 06:00 if that works.
Mike: I can cover 06:00-12:00 UTC to complete Sat.
Alex: Awesome, @Caroline + @Mike that works. I'll update the rota table and message ops. Quick notes for handoff:
- Current risk: infra will run a non-blocking batcher restart Sat 02:00 UTC as part of rolling updates (not expected to be an incident but could cause transient token-generation latency spikes).
- If you see >200ms p99 token latency or >5% 5xx errors on /v1/generate in a 5m window, escalate.
- Runbooks: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-latency (follow the "batcher restart" section).
- Escalation: page eng-sre oncall (pager duty) then ping me + Tara in slack.
Caroline: noted. Any quick checks you want us to run after the restart?
Alex: Yep — after the restart, run these checks:
```
# sanity checks
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://api.redwood/v1/health
redis-cli -h redis-main INFO | grep instantaneous_ops_per_sec
systemctl status batcher-service --no-pager
```
If any health check returns non-200, or token latency > 500ms, open a ticket and page eng-sre.
Mike: Got it. I'll monitor metrics and watch the dashboard (TokenPerf > 95th). If I see ansel spikes I'll take the first mitigation: reduce batch_size from 64 -> 32 for the affected pool via the Console route (Model -> Pools -> Edit). That usually helps.
Tara: Tagging a quick FYI — internal experiments next week might increase small-request traffic. If you see odd read patterns, it's probably the experiments team; I'll try to coordinate to avoid overlap but wanted to warn.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Scheduled maintenance: batcher rolling restart at 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z. Incident channel: #incidents (no known impact). :information_source:
Caroline: I'll take the first page if anything comes in during my window. I'll follow the runbook and contact SRE if required.
Alex: Thanks everyone. I've updated the rota: Sat 00:00-06:00 Caroline, 06:00-12:00 Mike, Sun 12:00-23:59 Alex. I'll DM both of you the temporary credentials and the playbook snippet.
Mike: Thanks — I'll set an alert for token p50/p95/p99 and add a lightweight PagerDuty rule to reduce noise.
Alex: One more small note: if batcher restarts cause KV cache warmup lag, some LLM responses may be truncated — watch for "incomplete generation" errors and treat as high priority to rollback to previous batcher config.
Caroline: Copy that. I'll be available via phone if paging triggers.
Mike: All clear. Enjoy the family thing Alex :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks! Appreciate the coverage.
